original_finding.first_contract: For each room opening, opening_light searches all resolved opening assemblies and chooses the first TimberShutter with origin within 0.01 m of the source wall centre and matching storey-adjusted sill. It does not compare the source wall/host identity in this predicate even though the resolved OpeningAssembly stores a host source. Missing match gives glass transmission and creates no shutter contribution; a match stores a typed OpeningAssemblyId for later scene-window lookup.
original_finding.safeguards: The caller already restricts source walls to exterior walls belonging to the room and excludes doors. The generator derives the resolved opening frame from a projected/return-adjusted wall span and an optional tangent offset; a common origin may also be produced for ordinary cases. A shutter starts closed, and the update later selects the first SceneWindow matching building and opening IDs, treating absence as closed.
original_finding.condition: For a missing match, an eligible shutter must be displaced beyond the tolerance and no different assembly match; for a wrong first match, distinct eligible assemblies must satisfy the same origin/sill predicate while representing different source openings. A supported generated or admitted plan, all scene/window identity and lifecycle guarantees, and observed daylight impact remain unproved.
original_finding.future_direction: Trace exact opening-to-resolved-assembly correspondence and legitimate shifted apertures, then choose an authoritative association or a precise ambiguity/missing-match policy.
